title: Zephyr: source precedence policy
description: Time source precedence policy. AC: Higher-quality sources take precedence, policy configurable.
close_reason: Implemented a bounded configurable six-class source precedence policy in Zephyr C with canonical GNSS-first defaults, full-permutation validation, deterministic tie handling, monotonic exclusion, and fail-before-output-mutation fallback across prevalidated source validity/freshness/authorization/rollback evidence. Added standalone and QEMU regressions for default/custom policy, fallback, stale/invalid/unauthorized/rollback candidates, duplicates, invalid enums, and exhaustion. Green: strict standalone C+UBSan, C11 strict compile, clang static analyzer, qemu_cortex_m3 4/4, Rust precedence/failover tests and no_std clippy, isolated Python parity.
